canon.silhouette: broad-planted, jagged multi-point base on six thick stub-limbs, low and wide rather than tall — the widest footprint and lowest profile of the three brood tiers, owning scale and stance the way the elite owns height and the walkers own low-and-flowing motion
canon.reads_as: the thing that plants itself and does not move — you go through it, not around it

prompt.description: Massive grounded brood-mass on six thick blunt stub-limbs, planted in a jagged, irregularly-spaced ring wider than the body above it. Body rises in one broad low mound, roughly half cell height, never rearing. A single subtle unmarked dorsal ridge runs the spine, flat and quiet. Amorphous tar-flesh surface, torn-membrane texture, zero bilateral symmetry, no straight lines anywhere on the body. The largest and widest of its kind, low-slung and immovable rather than reared.
must_include: six thick blunt stub-limbs in a jagged multi-point base ring
wide, low, broad mound body, roughly half cell height
single subtle unmarked central dorsal ridge
widest footprint of any brood tier
must_avoid: glow, self-illumination, or light emission of any kind
visible face, eyes, brow, or expression
reared vertical posture (reserved to the elite tier)
smooth continuous dome base (reserved to the walker tier)
negative-space hole through the body (reserved to the elite tier)
hard armor plating covering the whole body
any straight-edged or geometric shape on the unmarked base
